mapper.select: SELECT area.id, area.floor_plan_id, area.name, area.description, COUNT(inspection.id) AS inspection_count, MAX(inspection.updated_at) AS last_inspected_at FROM inspection_areas area LEFT JOIN safety_inspections inspection ON inspection.inspection_area_id = area.id WHERE area.active = TRUE GROUP BY area.id, area.floor_plan_id, area.name, area.description ORDER BY area.name, area.id
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM inspection_areas WHERE id = #{areaId} AND active = TRUE

SELECT inspection.id, inspection.inspector_id, inspection.status, COALESCE(SUM(item.result != 'PENDING'), 0) AS completed_item_count, COUNT(item.id) AS total_item_count, COALESCE(SUM(item.result = 'FAIL'), 0) AS fail_count, COALESCE(SUM(item.result = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'), 0) AS review_required_count, inspection.updated_at FROM safety_inspections inspection LEFT JOIN safety_inspection_items item ON item.safety_inspection_id = inspection.id WHERE inspection.inspection_area_id = #{areaId} GROUP BY inspection.id, inspection.inspector_id, inspection.status, inspection.updated_at ORDER BY inspection.updated_at DESC, inspection.id DESC

SELECT inspection.id, inspection.inspection_area_id, area.name AS area_name, inspection.simulation_result_id, inspection.inspector_id, inspection.status, inspection.comment, inspection.updated_at, inspection.completed_at FROM safety_inspections inspection JOIN inspection_areas area ON area.id = inspection.inspection_area_id WHERE inspection.id = #{inspectionId}
SELECT id, title, criterion, category, display_order, result, comment FROM safety_inspection_items WHERE safety_inspection_id = #{inspectionId} ORDER BY display_order, id
SELECT id FROM checklist_templates WHERE inspection_area_id = #{areaId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_inspections ( inspection_area_id, checklist_template_id, simulation_result_id, inspector_id, status ) VALUES ( #{inspectionAreaId}, #{checklistTemplateId}, #{simulationResultId}, #{inspectorId}, 'DRAFT' )

INSERT INTO safety_inspection_items ( safety_inspection_id, template_item_id, title, criterion, category, display_order, result ) SELECT #{inspectionId}, item.id, item.title, item.criterion, item.category, item.display_order, 'PENDING' FROM checklist_template_items item WHERE item.checklist_template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY item.display_order
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_inspection_items WHERE safety_inspection_id = #{inspectionId} AND result = 'PENDING'
